sentimento.text1: In the Polymarket winner contract, Flávio Bolsonaro stands at 84.25% (vol USD 16.11M cumulative) and Lula at 15.50% (vol USD 16.52M cumulative), confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, during the [first-round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) count. Against the confirmed reading of 03/Oct at 20:23 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 19.70pp and Lula falls 20.00pp, and since the pair's sum went from 100.05 to 99.75 the normalized move is 19.94pp for each side. Flávio Bolsonaro's gap over Lula goes from 29.05pp to 68.75pp. ⭐ Flávio Bolsonaro stands 20.95pp above the recorded top of the series since April 14, 63.30% on 01/Oct, and Lula 19.00pp below the recorded low, 34.50% on 25/Apr.
sentimento.text2: 🗳️ RESULT DEFINED BY THE [TSE](/en/glossary#tse): in the official TSE partial count of 21:44 BRT on 04/Oct, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied, Flávio Bolsonaro has 47.12% of the valid votes for president and Lula 45.06%, followed by Augusto Cury, with 2.89%, Ronaldo Caiado, with 2.19%, and Renan Santos, with 2.25%. At 20:58 the TSE marked the presidential result as mathematically defined: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula go to the [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno), scheduled for 25/Oct (Agência Brasil). The presidential book received USD 6.48M in new money since the confirmed reading of 20:23 BRT on 03/Oct, and totals USD 170.31M cumulative across 19 contracts.
sentimento.text3: 🗳️ THE POLLS OF THE EVE. In the nine national polls released on 03/Oct, the eve of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno), Lula is ahead in the first round in five (Datafolha, [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), PoderData, CNT/MDA and AtlasIntel) and Flávio Bolsonaro in four (Palver, Futura and two from Gerp, which reports that the two measurements share part of the interviews). After the panel's 03/Oct round two more came out: AtlasIntel (BR-00999/2026, n=4,945, fieldwork from 27/Sep to 02/Oct) gives Lula 46.7% to 43.8% in total first-round votes and 47.6% to 47.4% in the second, and Gerp's [second round](/en/glossary#segundo-turno) of the day (BR-08168/2026, fieldwork from 01 to 03/Oct) gives Flávio Bolsonaro 44% to 42% in the first round. Veritá released a sum of 27 state polls, 40,500 interviews from 26/Sep to 02/Oct, with Flávio Bolsonaro at 47% and Lula at 45%; it stays out of the chart because it is a consolidation of state registrations, the same rule as on 01/Oct. In the same reading, the second-place book of the first round paid 99.85% for Lula and the third-place book 99.85% for Augusto Cury, the same order as the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) result.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 84.25% in the winner contract (vol USD 16.11M cumulative), up 19.70pp raw and 19.94pp normalized, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, 20.95pp above the recorded top of the series, 63.30% on 01/Oct. 🗳️ He has 47.12% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied. He led the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in four of the nine national polls of 03/Oct, with the largest margin in Palver, 47% to 43%.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 15.50% in the winner contract (vol USD 16.52M cumulative), down 20.00pp raw and 19.94pp normalized, confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, 19.00pp below the recorded low of the series, 34.50% on 25/Apr. 🗳️ He has 45.06% of the valid votes in the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied. He led the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) in five of the nine national polls of 03/Oct, with the largest margin in CNT/MDA, 43.1% to 38%.
sentimento.terceiraVia: 🥉 In the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count of 21:44 BRT, with 99.59% of polling sections tallied, Augusto Cury has 2.89% of the valid votes, Ronaldo Caiado 2.19%, Renan Santos 2.25% and Romeu Zema 0.27%. In the same reading, the second-place book of the [first round](/en/glossary#primeiro-turno) paid 99.85% for Lula and the third-place book 99.85% for Augusto Cury, the same order as the TSE result. In the winner book Renan Santos's contract is at 0.05% and remains the one with the highest cumulative volume in the presidential book, USD 17.10M.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT (05/Oct, 00:43 UTC), with the presidential book totaling USD 170.31M cumulative across 19 contracts. AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp, contract by contract. Volume is cumulative since each contract opened. ⚖️ Alongside the raw move comes the move normalized by the pair's sum, or by the whole book's sum when it has more than two relevant names, because the sum of prices moves on its own. 🗳️ The count cited on this page is the official [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) partial count, with the time and the percentage of polling sections tallied. The poll side of the divergence chart uses ONE national poll, not the average: the rule is the most recent one, with ties broken by the largest sample, which gives Palver of 03/Oct, n=5,000, the largest sample among the national polls of the most recent day.

inss.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep EDSON FACHIN GAVE THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S OFFICE (PGR) FIVE DAYS TO WEIGH IN ON THE PENDING REQUESTS IN THE [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) AND MASTER CASE INVESTIGATIONS, among them requests to review or revoke detentions, as Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Estadão report. The decision settles none of the requests: after the opinion, the case files go back to him. The investigations have been with the presidency of the Supreme Court since 12/Sep.
inss.text2: ⚠️ WHAT SITS OUTSIDE THE GOVERNMENT'S COUNT HAS A FIGURE, AND IT IS STILL THE ONE FROM 03/Sep. Requests delayed beyond 45 days totalled 261 thousand in August, against 1.88 million requests in the full queue. The page keeps the previous figure because there was no new measurement, and it does not estimate.
inss.text3: The definition the government uses, given by the Social Security minister and quoted by Metrópoles on 03/Sep, is that clearing the queue means analysing faster than the legal deadline of 45 days, not having no request under analysis. The two sentences describe different realities, and the distinction belongs to the vocabulary rather than to the measurement.
inss.text4: 📌 ALSO ON 25/Sep, FOLHA DE S.PAULO REPORTS THAT THE DEFENCE OF A FORMER [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) PRESIDENT TURNED TO THE PRESIDENCY OF THE SUPREME COURT against a detention that has lasted more than 300 days; the act has a single source and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ The personal link between the INSS and the Master case recorded on 24/Sep remains the same: the plane Flávio Bolsonaro travelled on in 2025, linked to Daniel Vorcaro and to a lawyer under investigation in the INSS fraud case, and which the senator says belongs to a lawyer friend.
inss.impactoLula: This panel's approval benchmark is [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest), and its 03/Oct round (BR-02197/2026) measures 44% approval against 49% disapproval. ⚠️ Palver of 03/Oct measures 43% against 56%, according to Exame. Pollsters ask in different ways, and the panel does not add one to another.
inss.impactoGestao: Within [Quaest](/en/glossary#quaest) itself the approval and disapproval series is this: 48% against 47% on 05/Aug, 46% against 48% on 14/Aug, 45% against 48% on 02/Sep, 43% against 50% on 07/Sep, 43% against 50% on 14/Sep, 44% against 50% on 21/Sep, 46% against 49% on 28/Sep and 44% against 49% on 03/Oct. Approval falls 2 points after two rounds of increase, within the margin of 2pp. ⭐ In the same round's assessment the negative is at 42%, the positive at 33% and the fair rating at 23% (Money Times). These are two different questions and they do not add up.
inss.conclusao: On 01/Oct Lula signed a legal opinion that guarantees victims of domestic violence up to six months of leave with pay covered by the [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) (Gazeta do Povo, G1 and Valor). It is a benefit measure, not an act on the queue or on the investigation of the frauds. The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin opened on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to give its opinion on the pending requests in the INSS and Master case investigations expired on 30/Sep. In the polls, government approval ranges from 44.1% in Futura to 49% in Ideia among the national polls of 30/Sep and 01/Oct.

bancoMaster.text1: ⚖️ ON 25/Sep THE FEDERAL PROSECUTION SERVICE'S SUPERIOR COUNCIL KEPT THE PROSECUTOR-GENERAL, PAULO GONET, ON THE MASTER CASE PROCEEDINGS AND SHELVED THE REQUEST TO INVESTIGATE HIS CONDUCT. Against his removal the vote was 9-0. On the inquiry, which stood at 4-3 in favour of opening it with two votes still to be cast, the result was 5-4 for shelving, and the last vote was cast by the council's vice-president, Nicolao Dino, who was chairing the session because the proceeding involved Gonet himself (G1, Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). The rapporteur, Francisco Sanseverino, pointed out that the messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone do not prove direct contact with the prosecutor-general, and the four defeated council members argued for appointing a deputy prosecutor-general to take the inquiry further, according to G1.
bancoMaster.text2: 📸 ESTADÃO, ON 25/Sep, AND VEJA, ON 26/Sep, REPORT THAT DANIEL VORCARO ATTENDED, ON JANUARY 31, 2024, A LUNCH HOSTED BY GRUPO ESFERA IN HONOR OF GONET, in Brasília, with about 40 guests, which Gilmar Mendes also attended. VEJA publishes the banker's message from that day: "I'll be at the Esfera lunch with Gonet. Gilmar should be there". Gonet says he had no friendship with Vorcaro, and the banker's defense says it rejects the selective disclosure of private conversations. 📅 The five-day deadline that Edson Fachin gave on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to weigh in on the pending requests in the case, among them those linked to the detentions of Henrique Vorcaro, Felipe Vorcaro, Fabiano Zettel and Daniel Lopes Monteiro, expired on 30/Sep.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ This page's price for the contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 is from the confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, and stands at 3.40%, with vol USD 0.09M cumulative, 0.80pp above the confirmed reading of 03/Oct. AFOS does not attribute this contract's price to the case's news flow: it measures the two side by side, with each one's timestamps. 🏦 According to O Globo, the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) is investigating, in the inquiry into Daniel Vorcaro and Master's relationship with BRB, the bank's R$ 3.1 million financing to Flávio Bolsonaro for the purchase of a R$ 6 million mansion in Brasília; he says the transaction was legal, and the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. 🏷️ Still on the agenda, not an accomplished act: the Federal Police scheduled for the week starting 05/Oct the testimonies of André Esteves, Gabriel Galípolo and Roberto Campos Neto on the case (CartaCapital and Estadão).
bancoMaster.conclusao: The case moved on 25/Sep through two procedural acts, not decisions on the merits: the Federal Prosecution Service's Superior Council kept Paulo Gonet on the proceedings by 9 to 0 and shelved by 5 to 4 the request to investigate his conduct, and Edson Fachin asked the Office of the Prosecutor-General for an opinion within five days on the pending requests. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified; the ruling has been stalled since 15/Sep by Flávio Dino's request for further review. The request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's detention has been with Fachin since 18/Sep, undecided. ⚖️ On 02/Oct Edson Fachin created a rule to prevent requests from being directed to chosen justices (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo) and requested a meeting with the director-general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) about the mentions of justices in the Master case (Gazeta do Povo and O Globo).

stf.toffoli: He is the justice with the highest rejection in the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Estadão released on 23/Sep, a survey separate from the electoral one, with 1,852 adults interviewed between 17 and 21/Sep and a 2.0pp margin. On 24/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he voted to remove an opponent of Davi Alcolumbre from the Amapá election and that André Mendonça interrupted the ruling; the act has a single source and is recorded here as attributed. He remains the target of the impeachment request filed by Renan Santos and of the inquiry committee request by Alessandro Vieira.
stf.moraes: The ruling opened on 15/Sep on whether he should be investigated over his relationship with Daniel Vorcaro still has no date, suspended by a request for further review by Flávio Dino. On 28/Sep, according to G1, Gilmar Mendes adjusted his vote in that ruling so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the investigations are identified, and proposed internal inquiries; the account comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. On 25/Sep André Mendonça's filing on the report he used regarding that justice joined the list of pending requests that Edson Fachin sent to the Office of the Prosecutor-General, with a five day deadline. ⚖️ On the same day he was the rapporteur of the criminal case in which the Supreme Court convicted former congressman Eduardo Bolsonaro, 7-3, to one year of detention in an initially open regime for defamation against congresswoman Tabata Amaral.
stf.gilmar: 📺 On 01/Oct he ordered TV Globo to include Renan Santos in the presidential debate, at the request of Solidariedade, after Kassio Nunes Marques and Cármen Lúcia denied the candidate's requests; the broadcaster cancelled the debate the same night (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo). On 28/Sep, according to G1, he adjusted his vote in the ruling on whether Alexandre de Moraes should be investigated, so that it stays suspended until all the judges cited in the Master case investigations are identified, and criticized André Mendonça's handling of the case; the report comes from a single media group and is included here with attribution. ⚖️ On 24/Sep he took to the full bench of the Supreme Court a dispute over power plant court-ordered debts (precatórios) with an estimated impact of R$ 103 billion, after messages from Daniel Vorcaro's phone showed interest in the vote of one justice in that case (O Globo, G1 and Gazeta do Povo). 📸 Estadão and VEJA report that he was at the Grupo Esfera lunch in honour of Paulo Gonet, on January 31, 2024, which Vorcaro attended, and on 26/Sep he publicly defended Gonet after the shelving (O Globo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.dino: ⚖️ On 27/Sep, in a single-justice ruling on a complaint, he overturned André Mendonça's order at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) that required deleting a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida (Jovem Pan and Brasil 247), a decision that Luiz Fux suspended on the night of 28/Sep (G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). After the TSE full court released Tabet's post on 30/Sep, on 01/Oct he declared the case moot and closed the action (Gazeta do Povo and Valor). On the same day Edson Fachin denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove him from the cases linked to the senator, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). On 15/Sep he requested more time to review the case in the trial on the investigation of Alexandre de Moraes. On 02/Oct he publicly defended the rulings of the Supreme Court and the TSE on the TV Globo debate and Justice Estela Aranha (Folha de S.Paulo, Valor and Estadão).
stf.mendonca: His 76-page filing, submitted on 21/Sep, asks Edson Fachin for the summary dismissal of the inquiry against him and for consideration of opening an investigation into Alexandre de Moraes for abuse of authority. On 25/Sep it joined the list of pending requests that Fachin sent to the Prosecutor General's Office, with a five-day deadline. On 24/Sep his office received Flávio Bolsonaro's request to investigate the relationship between Lula and Daniel Vorcaro, and on 25/Sep Folha de S.Paulo reports that he keeps under seal the Master case proceeding in which he denied an operation against Cláudio Castro; the report has a single source and is included with attribution. 🗳️ Also on 25/Sep he ordered social networks to take down more than a thousand posts carrying the false story that Flávio Bolsonaro would strip Our Lady of Aparecida of the title of patron saint of Brazil (Gazeta do Povo, Folha de S.Paulo and CartaCapital), and in the criminal case against Eduardo Bolsonaro he voted for acquittal, outvoted along with Luiz Fux and Nunes Marques. ⚖️ On 30/Sep, at the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse) full court, he adjusted his vote to release Antonio Tabet's post and the cases of reasonable doubt, and the court upheld the removal of the posts that attributed to Flávio Bolsonaro the plan to strip the title of patron saint (Gazeta do Povo and G1).
stf.nexo: The link with the election is about the calendar and about institutions, not about the result, and there are two recent measurements of different questions, which do not add up. In the Datafolha poll released on 26/Sep, with fieldwork from 22 to 23/Sep, 33% say the conduct of the Supreme Court justices hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy more and 23% say it hurts Lula's more (G1). In the AtlasIntel poll in partnership with Bloomberg of 23/Sep, 52.3% say the crisis at the Supreme Court hurts Lula's candidacy more and 20.8% say it hurts Flávio Bolsonaro's more. One question is about the conduct of the justices and the other about the crisis, and both pollsters surveyed the same week.
stf.analise: THE CONTRACT ON A SUPREME COURT JUSTICE LEAVING BY IMPEACHMENT BEFORE 2027 STANDS AT 3.40% (vol USD 0.09M cumulative), confirmed reading of 04/Oct, 21:43 BRT, 0.80pp above the confirmed reading of 03/Oct. It is a thin book, and the price is 22.70pp from the series high, 26.10% on 11/Sep, and 1.30pp from the low, 2.10% on 08/Jun. 📺 On the night of 01/Oct TV Globo cancelled the presidential debate and attributed the cancellation to the court rulings of the preceding hours, which in the broadcaster's view created legal uncertainty (Gazeta do Povo, CartaCapital, G1 and Folha de S.Paulo). At around 18h30 Justice Estela Aranha, of the [TSE](/en/glossary#tse), issued an injunction barring the showing of Lula's empty podium and the questions directed at him, and Supreme Court Justice Gilmar Mendes ordered the inclusion of Renan Santos, which Kassio Nunes Marques and Cármen Lúcia had denied (Gazeta do Povo and Folha de S.Paulo). Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro had already announced they would not attend. Gazeta do Povo called the TSE ruling that made the debate unviable unprecedented. ⚖️ On 02/Oct Edson Fachin created a rule to prevent requests from being directed to chosen justices (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo) and requested a meeting with the director-general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) about the mentions of justices in the Master case (Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). ⛔ The panel does not link the contract's price to the day's acts: it measures both with each one's timestamp.
stf.fachin: ⚖️ ON 02/Oct HE CREATED a rule to prevent requests from being directed to chosen justices (G1, Folha de S.Paulo and Gazeta do Povo) and requested a meeting with the director-general of the [Federal Police](/en/glossary#pf) about the mentions of justices in the Master case (Gazeta do Povo and O Globo). On 01/Oct he denied Flávio Bolsonaro's request to remove Flávio Dino from the cases linked to the senator, to Lula and to the elections (G1, CartaCapital and Folha de S.Paulo). The five-day deadline he gave on 25/Sep for the Prosecutor General's Office to weigh in on the pending requests in the Master case and [INSS](/en/glossary#inss) investigations expired on 30/Sep, and since 18/Sep he has had on his desk the request to revoke Daniel Vorcaro's pre-trial detention.
